meta.name: prisma-mongodb-upgrade
meta.description: Decision and migration guide for Prisma ORM MongoDB projects on v6, which have no upgrade path to v7. Use when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to prisma 7" comes up in a project with provider = "mongodb", or when evaluating a move to Prisma 8. Triggers on "upgrade prisma mongodb", "prisma 7 mongodb", "mongodb prisma migration", "prisma 8 mongodb".

copy.tagline: 评估 MongoDB 项目能否升级 ORM 版本,并给出迁移路线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 MongoDB 项目想升 Prisma,却不确定能不能升、怎么升
copy.tagline_en: Decide whether your MongoDB app can upgrade its ORM, then plan the move
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your MongoDB project needs a Prisma upgrade and the path is unclear

howto.what: 处理 Prisma ORM MongoDB 项目的升级问题:判断该迁到 Prisma 8 还是留在 v6,并按参考文件给出模式、客户端 API、迁移流程的对应做法。它会指出 MongoDB 没有 v7 连接器,也不会让你改用 SQL 数据库。
howto.when: 当 MongoDB 项目问起升级 Prisma、提到「upgrade to prisma 7」「prisma 8 mongodb」等触发词,或评估迁到 Prisma 8 时接管。

say.text: 帮我判断这个 MongoDB 项目该迁到 Prisma 8 还是留在 v6。
我用了 $transaction 做多文档事务,迁到 Prisma 8 会怎样?
say.note: 提醒 Prisma 8 尚无 MongoDB 事务方法。

howto.what_en: For Prisma ORM MongoDB projects, it decides whether to migrate to Prisma 8 or stay on v6, and lays out the schema, client API, and migration steps. It notes MongoDB has no v7 connector and won't switch your database engine.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a MongoDB Prisma project asks about upgrading Prisma, mentions "upgrade to prisma 7" or "prisma 8 mongodb", or evaluates a move to Prisma 8.

say_en.text: My Prisma project uses the mongodb provider — should I upgrade to Prisma 7?
say_en.note: Explains MongoDB has no v7 connector.

say_en.text: Should this MongoDB project migrate to Prisma 8 or stay on v6?
say_en.note: Gives a direction from the decision table.

say_en.text: We use $transaction for multi-document writes — what breaks on Prisma 8?
say_en.note: Notes Prisma 8 lacks a MongoDB transaction method.
